# SupoClip

> SupoClip is an open-source AI video clipper that turns long videos into captioned, vertical short-form clips for YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and similar platforms.

SupoClip can be used as a hosted web application or self-hosted from its AGPL-3.0 source code. The workflow accepts YouTube URLs and uploaded video files, transcribes the source, proposes promising segments, scores candidate clips, creates face-aware vertical crops, adds word-synced captions, and exports platform-ready videos.

## Canonical website

- [SupoClip](https://www.supoclip.com/): Product overview, features, pricing, and hosted application access.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/FujiwaraChoki/supoclip): Source code, setup instructions, architecture, license, and contribution history.

## Product pages

- [AI video clipper](https://www.supoclip.com/ai-video-clipper): AI-assisted highlight detection, virality scoring, captions, and exports.
- [Open-source video clipper](https://www.supoclip.com/open-source-video-clipper): Self-hosting, source access, provider choice, and deployment tradeoffs.
- [YouTube Shorts clipper](https://www.supoclip.com/youtube-shorts-clipper): Workflow for repurposing long YouTube videos into vertical Shorts.

## Guides and comparisons

- [SupoClip Blog](https://www.supoclip.com/blog): Product comparisons and practical video-clipping workflows.
- [Best free OpusClip alternative](https://www.supoclip.com/blog/best-free-opusclip-alternative): Comparison of SupoClip's open-source workflow with OpusClip.

## Key capabilities

- AI-assisted clip discovery and candidate scoring.
- YouTube URL and uploaded-file inputs.
- Face-aware 9:16 vertical reframing.
- Word-synced animated captions and caption templates.
- Export presets for YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and Instagram Reels.
- Hosted usage or AGPL-3.0 self-hosting.
- Support for configured hosted language-model providers or Ollama.

## Important qualifications

- Virality scores prioritize candidates; they do not guarantee audience performance.
- The source code is free, but self-hosters provide their own infrastructure and any paid transcription or model-provider usage.
- Users should process only videos they own or have permission to repurpose.
- Product capabilities and pricing can change; use the canonical website and repository for current details.
